title: The office
description: Name the things on a desk, and say what they are for.
grammar: gender and articles, and the words for what things are for
grammarNote: Every noun in an office needs its article, and para says what a thing is for.

explanation.summary: An office is a set of nouns, and each one has a job. Para is the word that explains what something is for.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El escritorio, el papel, el calendario, el archivo, el mostrador y el teclado are masculine. La carpeta, la grapadora, la agenda y la impresora are feminine. La agenda is the diary, and el archivo is the filing cabinet or the archive.

sections.heading: What they are for
sections.body: Para says what a thing is for, and it goes in front of the noun with its article: el papel es para escribir, the paper is for writing. En says where it is: el papel está en la carpeta, the paper is in the folder.

examples.es: el archivo está en la oficina
examples.en: the filing cabinet is in the office

examples.es: la agenda está encima del teclado
examples.en: the diary is on top of the keyboard

items.note: Masculine: el archivo. It also means the archive.

drills.meaning: the folder is on the desk
the stapler is in the drawer

drills.prompt: El ___ tiene el mes de mayo.
drills.meaning: the calendar has the month of May on it
